summary: Graviton (ARM) CPU inference routing is implemented for pytorch and tensorflow. Changes: added inference_graviton sections to src/sagemaker/image_uri_config/pytorch.json and tensorflow.json (additive only, 26 registries, py38, cpu ubuntu20.04); added GRAVITON_ALLOWED_TARGET_INSTANCE_FAMILY and GRAVITON_ALLOWED_FRAMEWORKS in src/sagemaker/fw_utils.py; added _get_image_scope_from_instance_type and the -sagemaker suffix rule in src/sagemaker/image_uris.py (fw_utils imported as a module to avoid a circular-import failure); added graviton_pytorch_version and graviton_tensorflow_version fixtures in tests/conftest.py; added graviton_framework_uri to tests/unit/sagemaker/image_uris/expected_uris.py; added tests/unit/sagemaker/image_uris/test_graviton.py. Verification: test_graviton.py and test_dlc_frameworks.py passed (504 tests) and 159 other image_uris/framework tests passed, all run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the edited src because the venv's sagemaker resolves to the base checkout. Unverified: six modules fail collection with missing 'mock' module in the shared venv (including test_retrieve.py and image_uris/jumpstart); I did not install packages. Import orders verified in fresh interpreters. Nothing committed. Logging note: an Elastic Inference request on an allowed family returns the same URI but its warning mentions inference_graviton.
